pubmed.method: Two ranked samples per title-focused query when the query exceeds one page; filters remove duplicate DOI/title, unsafe/off-topic title patterns, errata, retractions, preprints and records beyond date cutoff. This is a discovery sample, not an exhaustive systematic search. Selected titles received a supplemental manual relevance and scope screen, and cross-topic titles were assigned to their strongest matching topic. Unattributed journal research briefings were excluded after Crossref checks. Individual abstracts and claims were not validated.

pubmed.method: Targeted DOI lookup for major open-source single-cell and multimodal tooling and measurement papers. DOI duplicates against the existing seed and PubMed sample omitted.

omicsml.methods: Reference list used for candidate discovery. Citation metadata independently resolved via Crossref or arXiv and checked for title alignment. Existing records, duplicate versions, off-scope leads, and unverified identifiers excluded. Original list text and illustrations omitted.

deduplication: Exact DOI or normalized title, preferring published versions when available.
